title: Going Stargazing with the Business Central Observatory

chapters.title: The Galaxy visualization and data sources
The Lens engine and markdown documentation
Searching the galaxy and navigating by system
MCP server integration and customer table queries
New Zealand localization queries and enum values

features.name: BC Observatory galaxy visualization
features.description: A visual representation of the Business Central world as a galaxy showing different systems like human resources, finance, and other modules that can be navigated and explored.

features.name: Lens engine for data aggregation
features.description: An engine that ingests data from Microsoft Learn, BC source code (BC 28 to BC 30), localizations, Microsoft Roadmap, and YouTube videos to build a searchable knowledge base of 30,000 markdown pages.

features.name: MCP server for BC Observatory
features.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides programmatic access to the BC Observatory data, allowing queries about tables, fields, and Business Central metadata through Claude Code or other MCP clients.

features.name: Search functionality for BC concepts
features.description: Ability to search the galaxy for Business Central topics such as sales post, VAT numbers for vendors, roadmap items, and videos related to specific concepts.

features.name: Galaxy navigation by system
features.description: Users can zoom into specific systems like Finance and discover connected concepts such as VAT linked to localizations.

features.name: Field schema queries via MCP
features.description: Ability to query AL table field definitions through MCP, returning field number, name, field class, and table relations for specific tables like Customer.

features.name: Cross-table field discovery
features.description: Query capability to find all tables containing a specific field, such as locating the city field across master data, customer, vendor, contact, resource, employee tables and address-related tables.

features.name: Learn article indexing
features.description: BC Observatory indexes and surfaces Microsoft Learn articles related to searched concepts, providing documentation references alongside other results.

features.name: Localization-specific metadata queries
features.description: Ability to query metadata specific to localizations such as New Zealand, including changes in BC versions and enum values related to that localization.
